tier_detection.notes: Cigna drug coverage policies use one tier only ('considered medically necessary when ONE of the following is met'), unlike UHC's proven/medically-necessary dual tier. Map all criteria sets to tier='medically_necessary'.

indication_detection.notes: Each numbered indication (1., 2., 3'...) contains its own A) Initial Therapy / B) Currently Receiving split. 'Other Uses with Supportive Evidence' indications (not FDA-approved) should be flagged with coverage_status='covered_supportive_evidence' rather than 'covered'.

step_therapy_dependency_detection.trigger_phrase: This product also requires the use of preferred products before approval
step_therapy_dependency_detection.notes: When present, this points to a separate Cigna Preferred Specialty Management (PSM) policy not contained in the drug coverage policy PDF itself. Extractor must flag record as incomplete for step-therapy purposes and list the referenced PSM policy numbers verbatim (e.g., PSM001, PSM017, PSM002) rather than guessing their contents.

combination_exclusion_detection.trigger_phrase: should not be administered in combination with another biologic or with a targeted synthetic oral small molecule drug
combination_exclusion_detection.allowed_concurrent_phrase: does NOT exclude the use of conventional synthetic DMARDs
combination_exclusion_detection.notes: Excluded drug list comes from the policy's own APPENDIX table (Biologics + Oral Therapies/Targeted Synthetic Oral Small Molecule Drugs sections), not a separate document.

coding_notes.notes: Cigna PDFs consistently provide only the drug's HCPCS J-code under 'Coding Information'. No administration CPT codes (e.g., 96413/96415) are listed in the source text -- extractor must leave admin_cpt_codes empty and flag for clinic-billing confirmation rather than inferring a CPT code.
